test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Our trainer asked for _______ on her for the next informative session.
solution: The correct answer is: **All eyes and ears**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"all eyes and ears"** means to be fully attentive and eagerly listening. (पूरी तरह चौकस और ध्यान से सुनना) • **Example: **The students were all eyes and ears during the guest lecture. • Hence, the correct answer is **All eyes and ears** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. **Complete Sentence**: *Our trainer asked for all eyes and ears__ on her for the next informative session.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Chasing rainbows** (कुछ ऐसा हासिल करने की कोशिश करना जो असंभव या बहुत ही असंभावित हो): Trying to achieve something that is impossible or very unlikely. • **Example:** He spends his life **chasing rainbows** instead of focusing on achievable goals. • **Being around the bend** (पागल होना): To be crazy or insane. • **Example:** After working non-stop for 48 hours, he seemed to **be around the bend**. • **Going bananas** (पागल हो जाना): To become very excited or angry. • **Example:** The crowd **went bananas** when their team won the match. 21b:Tb0e, The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
